name: gardenhub-browser
description: Browser (Playwright + Chromium) checks for the /garden Homestead page, driven from Go: gardenio/controller/internal/gardenhub/*_browser_test.go boots the page on an httptest server with the fixture farm and runs testdata/*_browser.js against it. Only playwright-core is needed here; `make test-gardenhub-browser` installs it and Chromium, then runs the Go tests. Without this directory's node_modules the Go tests skip. The same harness runs the golden-screenshot gate, TestGardenGoldens (`make test-garden-goldens`, GOLDENS.md).
